CustomField.description: Per-row status, not per-session status: with the append-and-count model every save inserts a new row, so this describes what THIS row is (an in-progress save, or the terminal submitted marker), not a mutable session state. Defaults to Open so GtmFormDraftController's Booking inserts (which never set this field) keep working untouched. GtmAssessmentDraftController sets Submitted only on the terminal row appended by closeDraft.
CustomField.label: Status
